verdict.rationale: Docs confirm Stripe handles BIN sponsorship and network membership (Visa/Mastercard partnerships) and program customization without the founder needing banking infrastructure (stripe-issuing-docs-14, docs-22, docs-6), and program management tools (controls, disputes, replacements) are platform-provided. However, there is no documented 'signup to first live card' timeline, and community evidence indicates the program has historically been invitation-only with a waitlist process, adding friction not reflected in a clear time-to-launch metric (stripe-issuing-comm-5, stripe-issuing-comm-9). Missing for 10: an explicit documented time-to-first-live-card metric, and clarity on whether invitation-gating still applies today.
